findings: Positive-charge Lorentz force gives mobility Mxy=+B/(gamma^2+B^2). Its divergence contributes +A_prime*partial_y_rho to the density equation.
Collocation term +i*ky*A_prime and Galerkin coefficient -ky*(p-q)*A_(p-q) have consistent signs.
The detector expectation is amplitude/2 times the real phased Fourier coefficient because ky is positive.
Calibration includes zero field and identifies friction; stationary position density and thermal small-mass assumptions are explicit. Density readout avoids local-current curl ambiguities.
